features.name: Anonymous / Guest Login
features.description: Launch the app and continue as a guest from the Getting Started screen.
actions: Tap Skip this nonsense or Continue as Guest on the Getting Started / login screen

features.name: Spotify Login
features.description: Log in with Spotify from Getting Started, enter credentials, and grant OAuth permission.
actions: Tap Log in with Spotify
Enter Spotify email or username
Enter password
Tap Log In
Grant OAuth permission

features.name: Search for Music
features.description: Search for a track, artist, album, or playlist and open a result.
actions: Tap the Search icon or tab in the sidebar or bottom nav
Tap the search field
Type a query (track, artist, album, or playlist name)
Tap a result-type tab: All, Tracks, Albums, Artists, or Playlists
Tap a result to open it

features.name: Play a Track
features.description: Start playback of a track from Search, Album, Playlist, or Home so the BottomPlayer appears.
actions: Navigate to a track via Search, Album, Playlist, or Home
Tap the track row or the Play button on the track tile

features.name: Full-Screen Player
features.description: Open the full-screen PlayerView from the BottomPlayer bar.
actions: Tap the BottomPlayer bar or swipe up
Confirm PlayerView shows artwork and controls

features.name: Playback Controls
features.description: Play, pause, skip tracks, and seek from BottomPlayer or PlayerView.
actions: Tap Play or Pause
Tap Next or Previous to skip tracks
Drag the progress slider to seek

features.name: Shuffle / Repeat Toggle
features.description: Toggle shuffle and cycle repeat modes on the full PlayerView.
actions: Open full PlayerView
Tap the Shuffle icon to toggle shuffle
Tap the Repeat or Loop icon to cycle off, repeat-all, repeat-one

features.name: View and Manage Queue
features.description: Open the queue from PlayerView, filter it, reorder tracks, and jump to the current track.
actions: Open full PlayerView
Tap the Queue icon
Tap search and type to filter the queue
Long-press and drag a track to reorder
Tap jump to current to scroll to the now-playing track

features.name: Add Track to Queue / Play Next
features.description: Add a track to the end of the queue or insert it to play next.
actions: Long-press a track or tap the options icon
Tap Add to Queue or Play Next

features.name: Download Track for Offline Playback
features.description: Download a track from the context menu or PlayerActions.
actions: Long-press a track or tap Download in PlayerActions
Tap Download

features.name: View and Manage Downloads
features.description: Open Library Downloads and cancel or remove a download.
actions: Go to Library
Tap the Downloads tab
Tap a download to cancel or remove it

features.name: Add Track to Favorites
features.description: Like a track with the Heart icon so it appears in Liked Songs.
actions: Tap the Heart icon on a track tile or in PlayerActions

features.name: Add Track to a Playlist
features.description: Add a track to an existing playlist or create a new one from the track menu.
actions: Long-press a track or tap the track options menu
Tap Add to Playlist
Select an existing playlist or tap Create New Playlist, enter a name, and tap Create

features.name: Create a New Playlist
features.description: Create a playlist from the Library screen.
actions: Go to Library
Tap Create Playlist or the plus button
Enter a playlist name
Tap Create or Save

features.name: Remove Track from Playlist
features.description: Remove a track from an opened playlist.
actions: Open a playlist
Long-press the track or tap options on the row
Tap Remove from Playlist
Confirm removal if prompted

features.name: Delete a Playlist
features.description: Delete a playlist from its page options menu.
actions: Open the playlist page
Tap the playlist options menu
Tap Delete
Confirm in the deletion dialog

features.name: Start Radio from a Track
features.description: Start a radio queue of similar tracks from a track context menu.
actions: Long-press a track or tap the track options menu
Tap Start Radio

features.name: View Album
features.description: Open an album page and play the album or an individual track.
actions: Tap an album cover or name from Search, Home, or Artist page
Tap Play for the whole album or tap an individual track

features.name: View Artist Page
features.description: Open an artist page, follow, play a top track, and browse related artists.
actions: Tap an artist name or avatar
Tap Follow
Tap a top track to play it
Tap an album in the horizontal list
Tap a related artist

features.name: View Time-Synced Lyrics
features.description: Open synced lyrics in PlayerView, seek by line, adjust delay/zoom, or switch to plain lyrics.
actions: Open full PlayerView while a track is playing
Tap the Lyrics icon or tab
Tap a lyric line to seek
Use zoom or delay controls if shown
Tap Plain Lyrics if available

features.name: Set Sleep Timer
features.description: Start a sleep timer from PlayerActions.
actions: Open full PlayerView
Tap the Sleep Timer icon
Select a duration from the sheet

features.name: View Track Details / Share
features.description: Open track details, share, or Song.link from the track context menu.
actions: Long-press a track or open the options menu
Tap Track Details, Share, or Song.link

features.name: Blacklist a Track or Artist
features.description: Blacklist a track so it is hidden or skipped in future playback.
actions: Long-press a track
Tap Blacklist
Confirm

features.name: Change Audio Source
features.description: Pick an alternative audio source for the playing track.
actions: Open PlayerActions while a track is playing
Tap Alternative Sources
Select a different source

features.name: Play Local Files
features.description: Add a local folder of audio files from Settings Local Library or Library Local Files.
actions: Go to Settings then Local Library, or Library then Local Files
Tap Add Folder and grant storage permission if asked
Select a folder containing audio files

features.name: Connect to Spotify Connect Device
features.description: Connect playback to a Spotify Connect device from Home.
actions: On Home, tap Connect Device
Select a device from the list
Confirm the connect dialog

features.name: Add a Custom Plugin
features.description: Install a metadata or audio-source plugin from Settings.
actions: Open Settings then Plugins or Metadata Sources
Tap Add Plugin
Enter or select the plugin source
Tap Install

features.name: Change App Settings
features.description: Change appearance, audio, language, or download settings.
actions: Tap Settings in the sidebar
Select a settings category such as Appearance, Audio, Language, or Downloads
Toggle a switch or select a dropdown option

features.name: View Logs / About
features.description: Open About for version/licenses and Logs for diagnostics.
actions: Go to Settings then About
View app version and licenses
Go to Settings then Logs
